text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and token latency for inference endpoints in az1c (us-west-2). Affected model: gpt-redwood-3b-v1. 5xx rate ~12% over last 5m. Auto-fallback started for some routes.

dave_oncall: I'm on it. Paging dave_oncall... :phone: starting triage.

alice_sre: Seeing increased NIC TX drops and retransmits on a subset of g5 instances in az1c. Kernel tx-queue growing, CPU idle. Pulling host metrics now.

bob_net: Confirming AWS console shows ENI degradation events for several hosts in us-west-2a. Checking VPC flow logs/NLB health.

carol_runtime: Latency spike lines up with kvcache miss rate and grpc retransmits. Sticky sessions seem to be failing then reconnecting -> spike/502s. Recommend routing traffic off az1c while we investigate.

dave_oncall: Initiating traffic shift to fallback regions and enabling burst capacity on Dedicated pools. Executing traffic op now: 

```
/infra/traffic shift --from az1c --to eu1 --percent 100 --dry-run=false
```

incidents-bot: Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/network-az-degrade. Handoff to bob_net for AWS engagement. :eyes:

bob_net: Opening AWS SR SR-12345678. ENI TX drop 90p ~ high, NLB target health flapping for g5-* targets. Requesting host-side tcpdump and instance-level logs.

alice_sre: Starting K8s cordon+drain for affected node to prevent kv-cache corruption and reduce retries. Commands: 

```
kubectl cordon az1c-g5node-457
kubectl drain az1c-g5node-457 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

dave_oncall: Customer impact: ~3% of requests saw 502/504, platform-level QPS for this model dropped ~18% after reroute. SLO risk for regional customers. Erin, lead customer comms.

erin_support: Drafting status update for status.redwood: "We are experiencing degraded inference performance from a subset of hosts in us-west-2 (az1c). Traffic has been shifted while we work with AWS. Investigating and will update within 30 minutes." Posting now.

frank_prod: Any ETA from AWS on root cause / fix?

bob_net: AWS investigating possible NIC offload/hardware issue on a small host set. No firm ETA yet. Asking for host reboots and network plane remediation.

carol_runtime: To reduce retry storms while hosts are flaky, applied temporary runtime config tweaks: 

```
{
  "max_concurrent_streams": "80 -> 40",
  "retry_backoff_multiplier": "1.5 -> 2.5"
}
```

alice_sre: After reroute and drains, 95th pct latency returned to normal on eu1-routed traffic. Remaining hosts in az1c still showing elevated error rates; continuing to keep them cordoned.

dave_oncall: Preparing handoff to night SRE (dana_sre) in 30m. Dana, you'll take ownership unless AWS confirms full remediation earlier. Pager: escalate if no fix in 60m.

dana_sre: Acknowledged. I'll take over monitoring and AWS coordination. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Incident updated: severity=SEV2, started=4967004321, assignees=[dave_oncall,bob_net,alice_sre], impact=partial, mitigation=traffic-shift/drain/runtime-tweaks.

erin_support: Status page updated; CS notified and we prepared templated wording for customers. Will prepare post-incident summary after resolution.

bob_net: AWS requested tcpdump + host trace. Coordinating secure transfer.

alice_sre: Uploading capture: scp to s3://internal-incidents/4967004321/tcpdump.pcap.enc and attaching to SR.

dana_sre: I'll keep watch overnight. If AWS requests host reboots, follow standard reboot authorization chart and document. Hourly updates until cleared. Good work.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation in place (traffic shifted, nodes drained, runtime backoffs). Monitoring for normalization and AWS SR progress."
